note: One de-identified record per participant. final_choice is the answer to question F1 in questions.json.

fields.id: Participant ID: matchup code plus a sequence number.
fields.matchup: The two builders this participant compared.
fields.seniority: Self-reported seniority level from the recruitment screener (taken from an explicit job title when the screener field was empty).
fields.profession: Broad occupational group derived from the self-reported job title.
fields.industry_sector: Broad sector derived from the first industry selected in the screener.
fields.company_description: Plain-language combination of industry_sector and company_size.
fields.gender: Self-reported. Categories with fewer than 5 participants show as Not reported.
fields.summary: One-line description: seniority, profession and employer type.
